title: Independently verify final report and HTML presentation against objective and constraints
scope: As an independent verifier, check whether the produced report and HTML presentation satisfy the user's objective, the six focus items, source-traceability requirements, and repository instructions. Do not simply trust producer handoffs. Update orchestration state with artifact trust verdicts and create follow-up/fix task files if verification fails.
goals: Verify coverage of all six focus items and the final deliverable path in reports/.
Check that capability claims trace to official documentation and unresolved items are not presented as facts.
Check neutral tone, newcomer suitability, no hype/slogans/emoji, and no unnecessary hard-coded model versions.
Check that no forbidden tmp/ or archive/ reads were required by final artifacts and that private shell configuration was not exposed.
If issues are found, create targeted follow-up task JSON files and leave trust verdicts low or partial.
non_goals: Do not read tmp/ or archive/ directories.
Do not make broad rewrites unless creating a small fix task is impossible and the issue is trivial.
Do not verify your own produced content if you were the T005 worker; this task requires an independent worker.
safety: Treat producer outputs as untrusted until independently checked.
Use primary or official sources for claim verification; if web access is unavailable, verify only against the existing T003 evidence and mark limitations explicitly.
Preserve state.json validity if updating it.
success_criteria: state.json artifacts_trust records verdicts for T002, T003, T004, T005, the report, and the HTML presentation.
If the objective is satisfied, state.json queue marks all tasks complete and blockers empty; if not, state.json includes concrete blockers or follow-up tasks.
Any created fix tasks include dependencies, scope, safety rules, and expected outputs.
